actions.help: Path or gs:// URI of the .nc or .netcdf4 file.
Path to save processed output. Used as-is if provided (.nc added only when there is no suffix).
Offset (m) along depth for transducer position in water (default: None = surface). Overrides Platform vertical offsets if set.
Transducer tilt angle in degrees, 0 = vertical (default: None). Overrides Platform/Beam angles if set.
Transducers point downward (default: True). Use --no-downward to disable.
Path to the converted EchoData file (.nc/.netcdf4/.zarr) the Sv originated from. Required for the --use-* options.
Use EchoData Platform vertical offsets to compute transducer depth (EK60/EK80 only). Ignored if --depth-offset is given.
Use EchoData Platform angles to scale echo_range (EK60/EK80 only). Ignored if --tilt is given. Cannot be combined with --use-beam-angles.
Use EchoData Beam angles to scale echo_range (EK60/EK80 only). Ignored if --tilt is given. Cannot be combined with --use-platform-angles.
Recompute even if an identical product already exists.
Base name for outputs (default: the input's base name).
Write the default-named output here instead of beside the input.

options.--echodata: the EchoData (aa-nc output) the Sv came from; needed by the --use-* options. Its content enters the product hash.
options.--output_path: Explicit output, used as given; '.nc' is added only when it has no suffix. Local path or gs:// URI.
options.--tilt: transducer tilt from vertical, in degrees
options.--use-beam-angles: tilt from Platform or Beam angles (EK60/EK80; not both)
options.--use-platform-angles: tilt from Platform or Beam angles (EK60/EK80; not both)
options.-o: Explicit output, used as given; '.nc' is added only when it has no suffix. Local path or gs:// URI.

scienceText.depth_offset: Transducer depth (m). Overrides the Platform vertical offsets.
scienceText.downward: Downward-looking by default; --no-downward (upward-looking) subtracts the echo_range term from the transducer depth.
scienceText.echodata: EchoData file: its content identity (not its path) enters the hash.
scienceText.tilt: Tilt from vertical (degrees). Overrides Platform/Beam angles.
scienceText.use_beam_angles: Tilt from the EchoData Beam group angles.
scienceText.use_platform_angles: Tilt from the EchoData Platform group angles.
scienceText.use_platform_vertical_offsets: Transducer depth from the EchoData Platform group.

aa-depth.summary: Add a depth variable to an Sv dataset (echopype.consolidate.add_depth).

aa-detect-seafloor.chaining: After aa-depth: aa-nc | aa-sv | aa-depth | aa-detect-seafloor ... The next stage receives the bottom line. For the cleaned Sv, run the chain in steps and take its path from stderr, or use AA_NAMING=legacy.

options.--apply: also write Sv with sub-bottom samples removed (kind sv)
options.--emit-mask: also write the below-bottom mask (kind mask)
options.--no-overwrite: exit 1, before writing anything, if any requested output exists and is not the identical product
options.--output_path: Explicit bottom-line output; the extension is forced to .nc. Local path or gs:// URI. Does not move the mask/cleaned outputs.
options.--param: Detector arguments. Both methods need var_name=Sv and channel=<an id from the 'channel' coordinate; quote it, it contains spaces>. basic: threshold (-50 = window -50..-40 dB; or (min,max)), offset_m (0.5), bin_skip_from_surface (200). blackwell: threshold (-75 or (Sv,theta,phi)), offset, r0, r1, wtheta, wphi.
options.--range-label: variable compared with the bottom line (a depth) to build the mask. Default echo_range, which equals depth only when aa-depth applied no transducer depth offset, tilt, or Platform/Beam offsets or angles; otherwise use 'depth' (the tool warns when they differ).
options.-o: Explicit bottom-line output; the extension is forced to .nc. Local path or gs:// URI. Does not move the mask/cleaned outputs.

aa-detect-seafloor.reads: One Sv .nc/.netcdf4 path or gs:// URI that has a 'depth' variable (aa-depth output); 'blackwell' also needs angle_alongship/athwartship (aa-splitbeam-angle). A file without 'Sv' is calibrated as EchoData first (compute_Sv defaults, recorded in the provenance as an implicit step).

scienceText.method: Detector (echopype dispatcher key), e.g. basic, blackwell.
scienceText.param: Detector arguments, parsed as Python literals ('10m' stays text). Arguments left out are hashed with the method's own defaults (read from the installed echopype), so writing a default out, key order, and 5 vs 5.0 give the same hash; pass integers where echopype wants them (bin_skip_from_surface=200).
scienceText.range_label: Variable compared with the bottom line (depth). Changes only the --emit-mask and --apply outputs.

aa-detect-seafloor.summary: Detect the seafloor line; optionally write a below-bottom mask and Sv without sub-bottom samples.
